name: FusionAttention
reference:
import torch
import torch_npu

def run(query, key, value, head_num, input_layout, pse=None, padding_mask=None, atten_mask=None, scale=1., keep_prob=1., pre_tockens=2147483647, next_tockens=2147483647, inner_precise=0, prefix=None, actual_seq_qlen=None, actual_seq_kvlen=None, sparse_mode=0, gen_mask_parallel=True, sync=False, softmax_layout="", sink=None):
    return torch_npu.npu_fusion_attention(query, key, value, head_num, input_layout, pse=pse, padding_mask=padding_mask, atten_mask=atten_mask, scale=scale, keep_prob=keep_prob, pre_tockens=pre_tockens, next_tockens=next_tockens, inner_precise=inner_precise, prefix=prefix, actual_seq_qlen=actual_seq_qlen, actual_seq_kvlen=actual_seq_kvlen, sparse_mode=sparse_mode, gen_mask_parallel=gen_mask_parallel, sync=sync, softmax_layout=softmax_layout, sink=sink)
description: Fused Transformer Attention Score computation. torch_npu.npu_fusion_attention with support for BSH/SBH/BSND/BNSD/TND layouts, sparse modes, dropout, position encoding, variable-length sequences. Returns (attention_out, softmax_max, softmax_sum, reserved, seed, offset, mask_length).
